title: Vampyre Slayer
start: Talk to Morgan in Draynor Village.

items.t: Beer or 2 coins to purchase a pint

recommended.t: Varrock Teleport, Explorer's ring 3 or a charged amulet of glory (unless the Draynor lodestone may be used)
Garlic (easily obtained during quest, reduces Count Draynor's ability to heal)
For lower levelled players, some food may be required for the fight

rewards.t: 4825 Combat XP lamp in either scl | Attack , scl | Strength , scl | Defence , scl | Constitution , scl | Ranged , scl | Magic or scl | Necromancy (requires level 10 in respective skill)

steps.t: Talk to Morgan in Draynor Village. [Chat: 2 What terrible threat? › Accept]
Go upstairs and search in the northern drawers to get a garlic.
Go to the Blue Moon Inn located in Varrock.
If you don't already have one, buy a beer from the bartender. [Chat: 1 A glass of your finest ale please.]
Talk to Dr Harlow. [Chat: 2 Are you Dr Harlow, the famous vampyre slayer?]
Talk to Dr. Harlow again to get a stake and stake hammer.
Go to Draynor Manor which is just north of Draynor Village.
Enter the manor and go to the east side.
Open the coffin in the back of the room.
Fight Count Draynor until he is almost dead, your character will then automatically use the stake hammer on him to kill him.
p: Locked in battle with Count Draynor.

get_inside.text: Teleport using an amulet of glory to the Draynor Market.
Home Teleport to Draynor lodestone just north of the village (near the portal to Death's office).
Use War's Retreat Teleport and immediately exit via the ground portal to the north of the village.
Use an explorer's ring 3 to teleport to the Falador cabbage patch and then run south then east through the stone wall and then south will teleport to the Draynor Market.
The master archaeologist's outfit hat's teleport function (collectors menu) to the Wise Old Man.
